sections.title: ^2^0[Failure to afford facility for inspection of books of account during search.]
sections.text: If a person, who is required to afford the authorised officer with the necessary facility to inspect the books of account or other documents, under

footnotes.text: Sub. for "Failure to comply with section 247(1)(ii)." by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-4-2026.
Sub. for "rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years and shall also be liable to fine" by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-4-2026.
